title: Update Contact section displayed email text

requirements.summary: Change the visible email text shown in the Contact section “Email Us” card to info.zeroplast@gmail.com without altering any other surrounding content or the mailto link target.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Contact section’s left card (“Email Us”), the visible email text in the span is exactly "info.zeroplast@gmail.com".
No other elements are changed as part of this edit (e.g., do not modify the surrounding card, headings, or other sections).

file_operations.description: Update only the email <span> text inside the “Email Us” card to exactly "info.zeroplast@gmail.com" while leaving the existing mailto href attribute unchanged and not modifying any other markup or text.
